title: twas-xcal: ancestry-aware null calibration for transcriptome-wide association studies
description:
twas-xcal provides XCAL-t, an ancestry-aware null calibration for summary-statistic TWAS tests (S-PrediXcan type) under polygenic backgrounds. The polygenic inflation slope of TWAS statistics is a weight-specific LD score of the GWAS population, so European-derived variance-control corrections are miscalibrated in other ancestries. XCAL-t uses an ancestry-matched LD panel, a moment-corrected estimator of the polygenic variance term with a Cauchy-Schwarz positivity floor, LD-score-regression estimates of the polygenic scale and intercept, and a delete-group jackknife Satterthwaite t reference for LD-panel noise.

The release includes a benchmark that counts false positives against an exactly known simulated null (3,540 gene models per ancestry, ~10^8 tests per setting, infinitesimal and sparse architectures), an individual-level GWAS check, an end-to-end benchmark with estimated polygenicity, and a real-genotype benchmark (1000 Genomes phase 3 x 12,453 MESA expression models; model-based). Version 0.2.0 corrects errors in v0.1.0 identified by an independent audit (see CHANGELOG).
